_doc: Who owns which kind of work. Read by runlib.owner_config() (runner + container tools). Haiku-only window (2026-11-25): visual_owner is lab-anthropic and allow_opus is false, so Opus is never started (visual-owner, helpers with --model opus, stuck-step escalate, switch_llm to opus, POST /runs with model=opus). The lab-opus profile remains defined and unused. To switch back: set visual_owner to "lab-opus" and allow_opus to true (or remove allow_opus), restore runlib.py / runcli.py / agentd.py / agent-guard from /opt/agent/backups/2026-11-25-haiku-only/ if those were patched, then systemctl restart agent-lab-runner. See that folder's ROLLBACK.md. Earlier rollback note: /opt/agent/backups/2026-11-24-model-ownership/ROLLBACK.md 2026-11-26 cache-fixes: still Haiku-for-everything; Opus/Fable unused; do not flip allow_opus.
